notes.title: 1.2.3 Patch Note
notes.notes:
- Item possession limit increased from 9,999 to 99,999.

- Fixed a bug where the number of remaining runs was not displayed when using Green, Red, and Yellow Gashapon.

notes.title: 1.2.2 Patch Note
notes.notes:
- Reduced the delay time of all item acquisition notification messages from 120 frames to 60 frames. Now you can continue to perform tasks faster when opening gashapon, as well as after obtaining items by clicking.

- Now displays the number of runs remaining when using gashapon.

- Conduct a gameplay survey.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/f6819bb94c90314c5285163a56edfb085106dee6.png
You can participate in the survey by clicking on the in-game icon.
If you complete the survey, you will immediately receive 100 Gems. (You can participate only once, and it will be available for approximately 3 days.)

- Added a loading image when communicating with the ranking server.

notes.title: 1.2.1 Patch Note
notes.notes:
- Now you don't have to open your inventory every time you want to use a Gashapon! Just input the number of times you want and the Gashapon will be used automatically for that number of times.

- Maximum energy(♥) limit expanded from 99,999,999 to 999,999,999.

- Fixed an issue where moving from an event map to another map would no longer allow you to enter the event map.

- Fixed an error where the extra event 'My Score' was displayed as 0.

- Some missing translations have been applied.
